annotations.title: Search up to 5 public Telegram channels for a keyword

description:
Search up to 5 public Telegram channels for a keyword. Runs Telegram's own channel search (t.me/s/<channel>?q=) on 1-5 public channels, merges the matches newest first (up to `limit`, default 20) with per-channel counts/errors. 404 when no channel exists, 502 when all fail; partial failures are reported in per_channel.

GET /tg/search — price $0.006 USDC per call, paid automatically via x402 on Base (only successful responses are charged; 400/404/502 are free).

channels.description: 1-5 comma-separated public channel usernames, e.g. markettwits,rbc_news

q.description: Keywords (case-insensitive). Several words = all must match. Hashtags match with or without '#', e.g. 'oil', '#Fed rates'.

name: search_telegram_channels
title: Search up to 5 public Telegram channels for a keyword
